evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha Guru parvat ke kendra se uthti hai — Cheiro ke anusaar iski sabse shubh sthiti. Prem mein pakke aur bharosemand, maan-maryada ka ooncha code, aur saathi ko safal dekhne ki mahatvakanksha. Ek baar dil diya toh jeevan bhar ka saath — aise log doosri shaadi ya alagav mein vishwas nahi rakhte.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — origin: centre of Mount of Jupiter

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Venus mount accha ubhra hua (par bahut zyada nahi) — pyaar aur saath ki chaah, doosron ko khush karne ki ichha, aur har roop mein sundarta ki kadar. Artists, singers, musicians ke haath mein yeh mount hamesha dikhta hai. Aap warm, lovable insaan ho — yeh aapka sabse bada asset hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Mount of Venus well-formed and not too large: desire for love and companionship, desire to please, worship of beauty; artistic emotional temperament; prominent in artists, singers, musicians

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Venus well-shaped + baaki haath normal = Cheiro ke shabdon mein 'excellent sign': natural magnetism aur attraction. Aapko try nahi karna padta — log khinche chale aate hain. Is charm ko rishte banane mein lagao, sirf impress karne mein nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — with the rest of the hand normal, a well-shaped Venus is 'an excellent sign': magnetism and attraction of one sex to the other

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha chhoti hai — prem ke unche bhaav (romance, samarpan, bhavukta) kam ubharte hain. Vyavharik rishte aapko zyada suit karte hain, par saathi ko express karna conscious habit banana hoga.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — the shorter the Line of Heart, the less the higher sentiments manifest

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha upar Jupiter ki taraf se uthti hai — mahatvakanksha aapke jeevan ki steering hai. Self-control zabardast hai; aap apni zindagi goals ke hisaab se chalate hain, mood ke hisaab se nahi.

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Is period mein bahut se writers, composers aur artists paida hote hain. Agar creative kaam aapko bulata hai, toh yeh aapka lane ho sakta hai — side project se hi sahi, aaj shuru karo. Aapki knowledge aur sensitivity creative kaam mein asset hai, liability nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — a great number of literary people, composers and artists born in this period

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ki parampara ke anusaar aapke janm-samay walon ko paani ke safar (nadi, samundar, boat, cruise) mein thodi extra saavdhani ki salah di jaati hai. Iska matlab darr nahi, bas tayyari: life jacket ka niyam maano, mausam dekh kar niklo, aur water-activity mein safety norms follow karo. Saavdhani hi shubh yatra ka asli tabeez hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XIV — water-travel caution birth windows; rendered as preparedness advice per safety policy

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Venus mount ke neeche haath ki badi khoon ki nali (palmar arch) hoti hai — Cheiro ke mutabik ubhra Venus = accha blood flow, strong circulation, robust health. Aapke paas natural stamina aur warmth hai; isse regular movement aur neend se maintain karo — yeh reserve khatam bhi ho sakta hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Venus covers the 'Great Palmar Arch'; a large Mount indicates plentiful blood supply, strong active circulation, more robust health
